testInstructions: Open Advanced Paste settings and enable the Paste as .jpg file action; set JPEG quality and save.
Copy a large image, invoke Advanced Paste, paste as JPG, and verify a .jpg file is produced with the configured quality.
Repeat with a transparent image and confirm transparent pixels are flattened to white; exercise the normal PNG action to ensure it remains unchanged.
